text.tspan: 10 regions: one module, one state per region, parallel runs, canary first
GitLab parallel: matrix REGION=[…10] → 10 plan jobs at once · apply canary → wait → apply the other 9 (or terragrunt run --all)
Region differences via data sources (AZs, AMI from SSM) + per-region vars (non-overlapping CIDRs). Check quotas & instance types per region.
Not 10 provider aliases in one state: slow, one lock, one region's API problem fails all. Terraform can't for_each providers
(OpenTofu 1.9+ can); AWS provider v6 adds a per-resource region argument for a few cross-region resources.
